items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they came to see me a couple of times in Hollywood. I told them I wanted to do their songbook.

ctx.x: I probably know their songs, but I may not know their name.

Oh, child, they‘ve got all kind of stuff, and they came to see me a couple of times in Hollywood. I told them I wanted to do their songbook. They were thrilled, and Johnny Mandel. But I‘ve got to get another record company, because well, Johnny didn‘t part company with them on good terms, which just comes down to they owe him a lot of money. I want to eventually. I‘m going to go with another label. I‘ve got a couple of offers, very good offers, but I don‘t want to get strung out. I just want to do, one year do…
